Puzzles in vendor/lichess-puzzles-2026-11/

Source: the Lichess puzzle database, https://database.lichess.org/#puzzles
(file lichess_db_puzzle.csv.zst, downloaded 17 November 2026, 6,193,530 puzzles).

Lichess releases its database exports under the Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal
public domain dedication: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
No rights are reserved; this note is a courtesy, not a requirement.

Rapid Coach uses a subset chosen by tools/build-puzzles.py (popular, often played, settled
ratings, up to four moves to find): 2,926 puzzles rated 400 to 1800 for the tactics courses, and
828 entries rated 400 to 2000 for the "tactics in this opening" chapters (op-*.json, chosen by
the OpeningTags column). Each puzzle keeps its
Lichess puzzle id, FEN, moves and rating; the puzzle can be seen at
https://lichess.org/training/<id>. Themes and popularity data were used only for selection.

Rapid Coach is not affiliated with Lichess.
